Management · BBA and MBA

Managers build the companies.

Learn how to take a product from the lab to the market. Study finance, sourcing, operations, marketing and sales, with AI as a tool for each.

Book a campus visit

Why this course exists

A prototype needs a supply chain, customers and a business behind it to reach the market. Engineers and managers work together to make those pieces fit. This programme teaches you to make business decisions with a practical understanding of the product.

Two degrees, four specialisations

The proposed BBA format is three or four years and the proposed MBA format is two years. Ask admissions about the duration and options at your campus.

AI for Business

Use data and AI tools to make decisions, automate work and improve how an organisation runs.

Supply Chain and Operations Management

Learn how to source, make and move products across India and the world.

AI for Marketing and Sales

Find customers, build brands and grow revenue with AI tools for marketing and sales.

Entrepreneurship and New Ventures

Take an idea toward a company by finding customers, setting prices, exploring funding and planning for growth.

Work alongside engineers

Management students can join engineering teams and work on bringing a product to market, from identifying the first customer to preparing for a factory order. Company projects connect coursework to decisions and constraints that businesses face.

Where it leads

Explore work in business analysis, operations and supply chain, marketing and sales, or start a company of your own.

For those who want the detail

The management programme pairs business fundamentals with company projects and product work. Cross-disciplinary teams use cost, customer and operations evidence to make decisions about how a product reaches the market.

Explore the founder path

Common questions

Which degree should I explore?

The BBA is an undergraduate business degree. The MBA is a postgraduate business degree. Ask admissions which entry routes apply to you.

Can BBA and MBA students choose the same specialisations?

The programme proposes the same four specialisations for both degrees. Confirm availability for your preferred campus with admissions.
